sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Rule. Rule is made returnable forthwith with the consent of the parties and is taken up for final disposal.
Learned APP waives notice on behalf of respondents-State.
3. By this petition, the petitioner seeks quashing and setting aside of the show-cause-notice dated 22 nd December 2023 issued by the Special Executive Magistrate, Hadapsar Division, Pune City.

entities.text: Special Executive Magistrate, Hadapsar Division, Pune City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The grievance of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the show-cause-notice issued under Section 110(a) to (g) is bad in law, inasmuch as, there is nothing to indicate in the said show-cause- notice that the petitioner is a habitual offender, which is a pre- requisite for issuing show-cause-notice under Section 110 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
He submits that reliance is only placed on one C.R. and that too the number of the C.R. is not mentioned in the said show-cause-notice.
5. Learned APP opposes the petition.
Perused the papers.
Section 110 Cr.PC is with respect to 'Security for good behaviour from habitual offenders'.

The said Section 110, under which the impugned notice is issued reads as under;
"110. Security for good behaviour from habitual offenders.--When an Executive Magistrate receives information that there is within his local jurisdiction a person who-- (a) is by habit a robber, house-breaker, thief, or forger, or (b) is by habit a receiver of stolen property knowing the same to have been stolen, or (c) habitually protects or harbours thieves, or aids in the concealment or disposal of stolen property, or (d) habitually commits, or attempts to commit, or abets the commission of, the offence of kidnapping, abduction, extortion, cheating or mischief, or any offence punishable under Chapter XII of the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860), or under section 489-A, section 489-B, section 489-C or section 489-D of that Code, or (e) habitually commits, or attempts to commit, or abets the commission of, offences,
involving a breach of the peace, or (f) habitually commits, or attempts to commit, or abets the commission of-- Anil Popat Sonawane vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 6 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178353629/

sentences.text: 7. A perusal of the said impugned show-cause-notice, which is at Exhibit-'C' at page 17 of the petition reveals that there is only one C.R. mentioned in the said show-cause-notice.

The C.R.
number has also not been disclosed in the said notice.

A single case would not attract Section 110 Cr.PC inasmuch as, it would not show that the petitioner is a 'habitual' offender or is so desperate or dangerous so as, to render his being at large without security hazardous to the community.

Although, it is orally submitted that in addition to the said one case mentioned in the show-cause-notice, there are 2 more 903-WPST.3373.2024.doc cases, the same would not justify invocation of Section 110 Cr.PC.

Contents of the show-cause-notice are important and the show-cause- notice only reveals one case, and as such issuance of a show-cause- notice under Section 110(a) to (g), in the facts cannot be sustained, being contrary to the mandate of Section 110.
8.

In view of the aforesaid, the impugned show-cause-notice issued by the Special Executive Magistrate, Hadapsar Division, Pune City dated 22nd December 2023, which is at page 17 of the petition, stands quashed and set aside.

entities.text: Special Executive Magistrate, Hadapsar Division, Pune City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 9. Rule is made absolute on the aforesaid terms.
Petition is allowed and is accordingly disposed of.
